list.name: variant
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT unnest(variants) AS __text, unnest(variants) AS __value FROM workflow_runs ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT status AS metric, count(*)::float AS value FROM tasks WHERE created_at > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY status ORDER BY count(*) DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN verdict = '' THEN '(running)' ELSE verdict END AS metric, count(*)::float AS value FROM tasks WHERE status IN ('COMPLETED','FAILED','TIMEOUT','CANCELED') AND created_at > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY verdict ORDER BY count(*) DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN error_category = '' THEN '(none)' ELSE error_category END AS metric, count(*)::float AS value FROM tasks WHERE status IN ('COMPLETED','FAILED','TIMEOUT','CANCELED') AND created_at > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY error_category ORDER BY count(*) DESC
SELECT created_at AS time, count(*)::int AS value, 'PASSED' AS verdict FROM tasks WHERE verdict = 'PASSED' AND created_at > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT created_at AS time, count(*)::int AS value, 'TEST_FAILED' AS verdict FROM tasks WHERE verdict = 'TEST_FAILED' AND created_at > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT created_at AS time, count(*)::int AS value, 'INFRA_ERROR' AS verdict FROM tasks WHERE verdict = 'INFRA_ERROR' AND created_at > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT created_at AS time, count(*)::int AS value, 'PERF_REGRESSION' AS verdict FROM tasks WHERE verdict = 'PERF_REGRESSION' AND created_at > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT created_at AS time, count(*)::int AS value, 'INCONCLUSIVE' AS verdict FROM tasks WHERE verdict = 'INCONCLUSIVE' AND created_at > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT d.serial, d.display_name, d.soc, d.status, d.fail_streak, c.host AS client_host, c.version AS agent_version, c.last_heartbeat FROM devices d JOIN clients c ON d.client_id = c.client_id ORDER BY d.status, d.serial

SELECT te.created_at AS time, d.fail_streak AS value, d.serial AS metric FROM task_events te JOIN tasks t ON te.task_id = t.task_id JOIN devices d ON t.device_id = d.device_id WHERE te.created_at > now() - interval '7 days' AND te.to_status IN ('FAILED','COMPLETED','TIMEOUT') ORDER BY 1

SELECT concat(t.workflow_id, '|', t.test_id) AS metric, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (r.result_json->>'duration_sec')::float) AS value FROM tasks t JOIN results r ON t.task_id = r.task_id WHERE t.status IN ('COMPLETED','FAILED','TIMEOUT') AND t.created_at > now() - interval '7 days' AND r.result_json ? 'duration_sec' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT concat(t.workflow_id, '|', t.test_id) AS metric, percentile_cont(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (r.result_json->>'duration_sec')::float) AS value FROM tasks t JOIN results r ON t.task_id = r.task_id WHERE t.status IN ('COMPLETED','FAILED','TIMEOUT') AND t.created_at > now() - interval '7 days' AND r.result_json ? 'duration_sec' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 20

WITH latest AS (SELECT project, variant, metric_name, value, task_id, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY project, variant, metric_name ORDER BY created_at DESC) AS rn FROM metrics WHERE created_at > now() - interval '30 days'), baseline AS (SELECT project, variant, metric_name, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY value) AS median_val FROM metrics WHERE created_at > now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY 1,2,3) SELECT l.variant, l.metric_name, l.value, b.median_val AS baseline, round(((l.value - b.median_val) / nullif(b.median_val, 0) * 100)::numeric, 1) AS delta_pct FROM latest l JOIN baseline b ON l.project = b.project AND l.variant = b.variant AND l.metric_name = b.metric_name WHERE l.rn = 1 ORDER BY abs(((l.value - b.median_val) / nullif(b.median_val, 0) * 100)) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 30

SELECT 'pending' AS metric, count(*)::float AS value FROM outbox WHERE published_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'stuck', count(*)::float FROM outbox WHERE published_at IS NULL AND attempts >= 3 UNION ALL SELECT 'oldest_age_sec', coalesce(extract(epoch from (now() - min(created_at))), 0)::float FROM outbox WHERE published_at IS NULL

SELECT date_trunc('minute', created_at) AS time, count(*)::int AS value, 'published' AS metric FROM outbox WHERE published_at IS NOT NULL AND created_at > now() - interval '1 hour' GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT date_trunc('minute', created_at), count(*)::int, 'pending' FROM outbox WHERE published_at IS NULL AND created_at > now() - interval '1 hour' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT id, event_key, attempts, left(last_error, 80) AS error_snippet, created_at FROM outbox WHERE published_at IS NULL AND attempts > 0 ORDER BY attempts DESC, created_at DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT d.created_at, d.task_id, d.actor, d.model, d.prompt_version, left(d.output::text, 60) AS output_snippet FROM decisions d ORDER BY d.created_at DESC LIMIT 15
SELECT created_at, actor, action, target FROM audit_log ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 15
